• How it works. SkySweep sees new replies on your posts as they happen, waits about 45 seconds for Bluesky's classifier to label the image, then hides the reply from your thread. Bluesky's labels for porn, nudity, and sexual are the signal, so it works on images and video. Text harassment carries no label and isn't covered.
• Two options: allow explicit replies from your followers, and what to do with the sender: hide only (default), hide and mute, or hide and block.

• Your threads, your call. The page lists your recent posts. Open any one to explicit replies and the guard skips it. If it already hid replies there, you can restore them in the same step. Pause the guard for 2, 6, or 24 hours before you run a reply thread.
• What you see. Every hidden reply lands on the hidden-replies page with one-tap restore. No inbox pings, no DMs.
